references.text: Instructions for making the table of showbread, which is now to be brought into the tabernacle
Instructions for making the lampstand (menorah), which is now to be placed and lit
Description of the placement of the table and the lampstand in the tabernacle
Bezalel makes the table of showbread according to the instructions
Bezalel makes the lampstand (menorah) according to the instructions
The law concerning the showbread that was to be placed on the table
The Levites' duty in handling the table of showbread
Instructions for lighting the lamps on the lampstand
The letter to the Hebrews mentions the lampstand and the table with the showbread as part of the sanctuary of the first covenant
The construction instruction (25:37) provides context for the usage instruction (40:4) regarding the placement of the lamps.
The description of the holy materials of the lampstand (25:31) adds depth to its use (40:4).
The contrast between the setup (40:4) and the protective packing (Num 4:9) highlights the sacred status of the object in both phases.
